item: Main red since #1426 on two event-loop tests: the airplane-mode entity test left a resolver answering [] on socket.getaddrinfo
summary: tests/test_event_loop_signal_exemption.py boots a real server and probes /api/health with urllib; in the full suite (CI's two test jobs, three of three local runs) both tests failed with 'did not become healthy within 60 s', alone and in subsets they passed. Shown by recording the test process's resolver at the failure: socket.getaddrinfo was the stand-in lambda of tests/test_entity_spine.py::test_airplane_mode_refuses_by_name_with_the_socket_guard_armed_and_ZERO_resolutions, answering an empty list (urlopen raised 'getaddrinfo returns an empty list' while the server sat idle and logged no request). That test replaced airplane._orig_getaddrinfo through monkeypatch and called uninstall_airplane_socket_guard() before the undo; uninstall copies _orig_getaddrinfo onto socket.getaddrinfo, so the stand-in stayed for the rest of the worker. Fix: the test restores the stand-in first and asserts socket.getaddrinfo is the original (red without it). Boot time under the test's own env is 10.0-13.2 s (52 boots beside a full -n 4 suite, median 11.2 s; idle 10.0-10.7 s), so no wait was widened. The other four files that swap _orig_getaddrinfo (airplane_socket_guard, egress_window, ssrf_connect_guard, transport_follows_setting) already restore before uninstall.
